objective: Map standards baseline entries into evidence-gated controls that can only progress to MET or EXCEEDED when supporting evidence and assessment requirements are attached.
claims_boundary: This control matrix records standards mapping, evidence targets, readiness posture, and gating rules only. It does not establish certification, accreditation, CMMC conformity, NIST SP 800-171 implementation, DFARS satisfaction, FedRAMP authorization, ISO certification, SOC 2 attestation, BAE validation, DOE validation, supplier approval, export-control clearance, classified access, external reproduction, hardware performance, field performance, or operational authority.

meet_or_exceed_gate.rule: MET and EXCEEDED require mapped implementation evidence, assessment method, passing automated or documented manual check, claims boundary, gap disposition, and formal/external assessment evidence when the standard or customer context requires it.
